literal_meaning: শরীরে ফোসকা পড়া (blisters appearing on the body)
figurative_meaning_en: To feel extremely uncomfortable or intolerable; to become jealous or envious
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার নতুন গাড়ি দেখে আমার গায়ে ফোসকা পড়ে গেল।
এই গরমে বাইরে যাওয়া ভাবতেই গায়ে ফোসকা পড়ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Seeing his new car made me green with envy.
Just thinking about going out in this heat gets under my skin.
note: This idiom vividly captures physical discomfort as a metaphor for emotional irritation, common in colloquial Bengali.
